Overview

Nicoya is a city in GU with a population of 50,000. The heart of Costa Rica’s Blue Zone, a region known for the longevity of its residents and traditional way of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
